kit.name: El Refugio Lógico — Visual Asset Kit
kit.description: Assets pixel-art dibujados como comandos Canvas 2D. No son descripciones: cada asset contiene su geometría, estados, hitbox y metadata para renderizarlo directamente.

renderer_contract.coordinates: local pixel coordinates relative to asset top-left
renderer_contract.coordinatePolicy: x/y/w/h/points/width are integers; alpha/rx/ry may be fractional; primitives stay within size bounds
renderer_contract.depth: worldY represents anchor; sort by worldY - asset.anchor.y + asset.depth.footY; fallback worldY + asset.depth.offsetY
renderer_contract.collision: use asset.hitbox translated from the top-left derived from anchor
